field_guidance.rights: id, brand_id, type, holder_party_id, territory, document_stated (application_number, registration_number, title_or_mark, dates, class_system, classes, status), material_ids, page_refs, registry_verification (status, source_url, checked_at, findings), authority_verification, scope_assessment; do not infer current validity from document_stated; for patent/design route use references/patents-designs.md comparison fields; for copyright record work classification, registration and litigation readiness per references/evidence.md without making registration a notice prerequisite
field_guidance.targets: id, supplied_url, normalized_domain, final_url, seller_id, relationship_to_other_targets, relationship_evidence_ids; status (open by default; closed/withdrawn/verified_effective/closed_no_action only with basis), channel_plan [{provider_id (nullable while researching), route}]; recorded planned routes are scope, not proof of provider attribution
field_guidance.allegations: id, target_id, claim, reported_by, reported_at, basis_evidence_ids, counter_evidence_ids, assessment, uncertainty
field_guidance.observations: id, target_id, observed_at, timezone, method, fact, evidence_ids, limits; never silently promote an allegation to observation
field_guidance.evidence: id, source_url_or_document, acquired_at, timezone, method, environment, original_path, derived_from_id, sha256, supports, limitations, disclosure_class
field_guidance.providers: id, target_id, role, organization, attribution_evidence_ids, confidence, official_report_url, policy_url, verified_at
field_guidance.actions: id, target_ids, provider_id, route, legal_or_policy_basis, claim_evidence_ids, requested_remedy, final_text_path, attachments, authorization_scope_and_source, signature_authority, disclosure_review, fees, status, submitted_at, submission_version_hash, receipt_path, ticket_id, decision, verification; followup (receipt_verified, delivery_state, expected_response_due_at, response_due_basis, last_substantive_response_at, last_sent_followup_at, unanswered_reminders, cooldown_until, channel_policy_url, policy_checked_at, next_action, blocker); corrects_action_id (independent correction referencing original action), claim_frozen, correction_reason, affected_prior_notice_ids, requested_correction, correction_acknowledgement, restoration_verification; followup.all_outbound_not_before applies only to a verified restriction on ALL outbound messages; cooldown_until applies to remind/resubmit only
field_guidance.action_status_values: researching, draft, awaiting_evidence, ready_for_review, authorized, submitted, acknowledged, needs_information, rejected, appealed, counter_notified, action_reported, verified_effective, verified_partial, not_verified, closed_no_action, withdrawn, correction_pending
field_guidance.deadlines: id, action_id, notice_path, trigger_event, triggered_at, local_timezone, rule_source, business_or_calendar_days, due_at, calculation_basis, verified_by, owner, status; unknown due_at remains null
field_guidance.acceptance_checklist: requirement, case_or_check, artifact_version, evidence_ids, environment, verified_at, result, remaining_gap; keep failed and unverified requirements
field_guidance.brand_id: Stable case-local brand identifier; do not infer from the prior case or automatically attach another brand rights holder
field_guidance.markets: Explicitly selected countries/jurisdictions only. Keep broad user wording in intake.requested_market_scope; unknown markets remain empty, with status unknown or needs_clarification
field_guidance.intake: Record user-provided facts and their origins; work_mode is not proof of permission to submit, sign or pay; filled case data lives outside the shared Skill/repository
field_guidance.parties: id, legal_name_original, name_aliases, role, relationship_to_user, authorization_evidence_ids, verification_status; preserve different entities until their relationship is supported
field_guidance.material_sources: id, kind (directory/file/attachment/authorized_link), location, provided_by, provided_at, authorized_read_scope, disclosure_limits
field_guidance.materials: id, source_id, source_path, sha256, media_type, pages, classification, brand_id, extraction_method, reviewed_pages, document_stated, uncertainties, possible_right_ids; a file name is not classification proof
field_guidance.jurisdiction_research: jurisdiction, reason_for_selection, user_scope_source, official_sources, checked_at, supported_routes, status, gaps; unknown/uncovered jurisdictions require official research
field_guidance.follow_up: Enable only for requested ongoing work; keep source access and sending authority distinct; scheduler configuration is not proof of execution. Missing/failed feedback access is not no-response.
field_guidance.followup_tasks: id, action_id (nullable for read-only checks), target_ids, kind, status, due_at (ISO-8601 with offset), due_basis, not_before, dedupe_key (required for outbound candidates), prerequisite_evidence, reason, completed_at, outcome; queue kinds/statuses are in scripts/followup_queue.py. Times must come from verified notices/policies or labeled operational defaults, not guessed business-day calculations. In-progress claims use run_id, claimed_at, lease_expires_at; blocked tasks require reason and review_at. A task with explicit target_ids covers only those targets; otherwise it inherits action.target_ids. Recovery candidates do not modify the stored task.
field_guidance.outbound_attempts: id, task_id, action_id, dedupe_key, recipient, thread_or_ticket_id, payload_hash, evidence_version, authorization_source, status (prepared/in_flight/sent/outcome_unknown/confirmed_not_sent), attempted_at, sent_at, receipt_or_message_id, reconciliation; uncertain delivery suppresses repeat sends until reconciled; run_id binds the executor; retain historical tasks/actions for reference validation; prepared also requires reconciliation on resumption; persist in_flight successfully before calling a sender
field_guidance.runs: id, scheduler_id, started_at, completed_at, source_read_results, source_coverage, due_task_ids, decisions, observed_changes, outbound_attempt_ids, errors, record_revision_before, record_revision_after; preserve failures and distinguish read-only trial from scheduled execution; status (running/completed/interrupted), interrupted_at, interruption_evidence; lease expiry alone is not evidence of interruption
field_guidance.revision: Increase after each persisted update; use real serialization/exclusion and atomic writes. This field alone is not a lock.
field_guidance.feedback_sources: id, connector, account_scope, authorized_thread_or_ticket_ids, verified_recipients, authorization_source, access_status, last_successful_read_at; processed message keys include source/account scope; source_cursors identify source_id, cursor, coverage and committed revision
field_guidance.validation: scripts/followup_queue.py performs read-only minimum queue integrity/reference checks and returns per-record errors, recovery_tasks, coverage_gaps, deferred_tasks, deadline_conflicts; not a full legal/schema validator or sender. Read references/case-format.md for version migration and output semantics.
